messages.content: Please look in the /projects folder for any .txt files, then scan the living_room devices and find the smart_light with device_id light_living. Check its status and prepare a restart request for it. After that, find the discovered lock ticket for the living_room and archive it in the app as a high-priority Maintenance lock audit for u_alice. Then lock the main door lock lock_main by setting its state to lock using PIN 2026. Send u_bob the message “Area secured and maintenance workflow started.” Also alert alice in the app with the high-priority message “Maintenance completed and the lock has been secured.” Finally, create a document titled “IoT maintenance log” containing “Device status checked, restart request prepared, lock audit archived, and stakeholders notified.” Include the tags iot, maintenance, and security, and send it as a high-priority app alert to u_alice.
